limitations: Historical simulations are not live returns or evidence of a profitable edge.
Each evaluation window starts from its own fresh simulated capital; these are not one combined live portfolio.
Later BTC hypotheses reused dates, and ETH/SOL candidates were transferred from that research. The full process is not a pristine unseen holdout.
No ETH/SOL asset-strategy pair passed the positive development-plus-validation screen in the archived study.
Mainnet/testnet and historical contract rules, fees, precision and maintenance margin can differ.
The new bounded spot cost-report service and these older 5x/10x intraday simulations use different engines and assumptions.
